description: Search One's Vibe — a curated gallery of live, tryable AI-built products — for prior art similar to an idea. Use when a maker describes something they want to build (e.g. "an online chess game") and wants to see what already exists: live examples they can open and try, how each is built (detected stack, AI tools), and a usage signal (deduplicated try counts). Returns evidence to reference, not a verdict — the maker decides what to build or change.

limit.description: How many results to return (1-20, default 8).

query.description: The idea or product description to find similar live projects for, e.g. 'online chess game' or 'AI recipe generator'.

name: search_similar_projects
title: Search similar live projects on One's Vibe
